featured_reviews.name: Vedant Raut (Vedanta)
featured_reviews.review_text:
Been visiting to this gem of a restaurant since my childhood days.  Its a pure veg restaurant and since their initial days as a eatery with only 8 tables,  now they have come a long way with around 9 tables on the ground floor and 10 tables on the upper deck with a centralized air conditioning.  The upper desk is what I prefer personally as they have really made some classy interiors in the recent times.  There is a long rectangular area with comfortable cozy sitting where staff always attends to your requests.

Note : One special table towards the end on the upper desk is best for dates or family dinner.  Its secluded & offers a private feel.

We ordered some starters like Tandoori Mushroom and Pahadi paneer,  the preparation along with the presentation was on the target (feel it through the pictures below) . They also offer some amazing breakfast items like various types of dosa, idli,  upma,  sheer,  medu vada,  pizza.  Juices here are good too.

Further,  you cannot afford to miss their Dal Khichadi and Palak khichadi, top notch perfection in taste with a perfect creamy blend of texture on both.

Try their various starters.  They dont disappoint.

Just one request Dear Sawali,  to justify your prices, pour in some more quantity.

featured_reviews.name: Sarbjeet Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Naaz Family Restaurant – A Taste of Tradition | ★★★★☆ (4/5)

Humara Naaz, Kurla ka Swad!
Naaz Family Restaurant has been a beloved part of Kurla since 1968 – a true culinary landmark nestled conveniently near Phoenix Market City. Stepping into Naaz feels like stepping into a flavorful legacy passed down through generations.

What I Loved:

Authentic Flavors: Every bite spoke volumes about their time-honored recipes. You can taste the richness and tradition in each dish – it’s clear they've been perfecting their craft for decades.

Warm, Family Atmosphere: Despite the lively crowd, the place radiates warmth. It’s cozy, familiar, and perfect for a wholesome family meal.

Prime Location: Just a stone’s throw from Phoenix Market City, it’s easy to find. Their multiple contact numbers also reflect their efficiency with deliveries and takeaways.

What Could Be Better:

Food Consistency: While most dishes were excellent, I noticed slight variation in quality – possibly due to the high rush hours.

Crowded Seating: The place tends to get packed, especially during peak times. Better space management or a seating upgrade would go a long way.

Ambiance: The decor feels a bit dated. A little refresh could add charm without losing its traditional essence.

Final Thoughts:
If you're looking for authentic, flavorful comfort food served with a side of nostalgia, Naaz Family Restaurant is a must-visit. It’s a true reflection of Mumbai’s culinary heritage, and with a few small tweaks, it could easily shine even brighter.

Visited Persian Darbar and it truly lives up to its name, it felt grand in every sense ✨

featured_reviews.name: Naincy
featured_reviews.review_text:
Overview
Persian Darbar has a fantastic vibe and top-tier hospitality, but the food experience was a bit of a hit and miss. Some dishes were great, while others didn't quite hit the mark given the high prices.
Pros
* Stunning Ambiance: The decoration is beautiful and creates a very premium feel.
* Proactive Service: The staff is excellent; they anticipate your needs even before you ask.

featured_reviews.name: Kadambari Nachare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointed with the billing practices at this restaurant. While the food was acceptable, the way customers are charged for basic packaged items is unacceptable.
On 20 June 2026, we were charged ₹55 for a bottle of water and ₹75 for a Sprite. These are standard packaged products with a printed MRP, yet the restaurant charged significantly higher prices. It felt like customers were being taken advantage of simply because they were dining in.
When you're already paying restaurant prices for food, charging such inflated rates for packaged water and soft drinks leaves a very poor impression. Transparency and fairness in billing are basic expectations, and unfortunately this restaurant failed on both counts.
I would advise customers to carefully check their bills before paying. The food alone is not enough to justify feeling overcharged at the end of the meal

featured_reviews.name: Farhan Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hitchki s one of the most popular restaurants in Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC), known for its Bollywood-inspired interiors and innovative Indian menu. The moment you walk in, the lively ambience, desi décor, and upbeat music set the tone for a great dining experience. It’s a perfect spot for casual dinners, celebrations, and influencer-friendly content.

We tried a mix of starters, mains, and desserts, and every dish delivered on flavour. The Nacho Nacho Regular was crunchy and addictive, while the Mangalorean Roast Chicken brought authentic coastal flavours to the table. The Godfather Chicken was rich and indulgent, and the Malvani Kolambi Masala stood out with its bold spices and perfectly cooked prawns—easily one of the best seafood dishes in BKC.

Dessert lovers should not miss the Lotus Biscoff Tiramisu, which was smooth, creamy, and beautifully balanced. Paired with their signature drinks like BBC, Hitchki (BKC) proves why it’s among the best restaurants and bars in BKC. Highly recommended for great food, lively vibes, and a memorable dining experience.

featured_reviews.name: Avish Navsaria
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hitchki is a great place to enjoy great vibes with energetic music, Dj and delicious food. They have a great ambience with plenty of safe and amazing seating arrangement. They have great menu with innovative names for all their dishes making it even more exciting to order. The service is very fast and good. The drinks are worth trying and of great innovation. The dishes I tried here were:

1) BIHARI KEBAB: It had Specialty Of Chef Dipesh + Age Old Recipe + Dry Masala Rub +
Tandoori Chicken + Tamatar Chutney. Must try.

2) CAESAR CHICKEN TIKKA: It had Parmesan Malai Marinade + Tandoor Cooked Chicken +
Garlic Parmesan Aioli.

3) ASIAN KITCHEN (CHICKEN): We customised it with Hakka Noodles + Manchurian Garvy + Chicken added. Really tasty and amazing.

4) DESI GIRL COCKTAIL: It has Tequila, Orange Marmalade, Desi Magoi Masala Punch, Red Wine Float + Chakna on top, perfect for a drink.

5) DEEWAR COCKTAIL: It has Whisky + Spiced Jaggery + Bitters + Apple Wood Smoke, amazing presentation and worth trying.

6) GODFATHER CHICKEN: It had Italian Herb Grilled Chicken + Potato Wedges + Sautéed Veg +
Mushroom Pepper Brown Sauce. Perfect for a person who wants to stay on proper diet.

7) Jungle Jungle Pata Chala Hai: A delicious dessert which has Black Forest Pastry 2.0 + Dark Chocolate Mousse + Cherry Mousse +
White Chocolate Ganache + Cherry Gel + Milk Chocolate Shavings.

It’s an all together complete place to visit with great music, food, drinks and service.

featured_reviews.name: Rimita D
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Hitchki at BKC, around 7-10 minutes from Kurla station by auto/4 wheeler. It's a vibrant Bollywood themed restaurant and a perfect evening party spot. The presentation of every dish was top-notch.
We tried Masala Soda, Main Toh Superman, Tiger Jhinga Hai, Prawns Jaaye Par, Pressure Cooker Chicken Tikka Biryani, Godfather Chicken, and Lotus Biscoff Tiramisu all impressive, especially the above appetizers which are highly recommended. Chicken lovers must try the Godfather Chicken for its great portion size and taste.
Lotus Biscoff Tiramisu wasn’t overly sweet and made a perfect ending. Loved the playlist too, you will surely vibe on it. Special thanks to Salman and the entire team for the excellent service.

featured_reviews.name: Prakash Dhalwani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hitchki BKC is a great spot for a fun lunch or evening out! The vibe is absolutely lovely — beautiful interiors with a cool bar-like feel that makes the whole experience enjoyable.

We tried quite a spread — nachos with cheese, garlic cheese bread, truffle fries, butter chicken seekh kebab, and paneer chilly, and everything was delicious! The truffle fries and seekh kebab were personal favourites. The only miss for us were the butter garlic prawns, which didn't quite live up to the rest of the menu.

Service was prompt and attentive, and we didn't have to wait long for a table at lunch — always a bonus! Valet parking is available which is super convenient for BKC.

Overall a solid dining experience and would definitely recommend it for the vibe and food. Will be back to explore more of the menu! 🙌

featured_reviews.name: Jinal Tank
featured_reviews.review_text: We tried a variety of dishes at Hitchki and had a great experience. The spring rolls and fried dumplings were crispy and tasty. Paneer makhani was rich and creamy with soft naan, while the noodles with Manchurian gravy were flavorful and filling. Ordered their new Dhurandar chicken which was quite average, the rotis served with it were a disaster, they felt raw hardly even roasted in the tandoor. When we conveyed the same to the person who served us (who also turns out to be the manager) was straight up arrogant and replied that he could only microwave it. The basics of service is to first listen here it's the opposite when he gives us such great suggestions.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this place and absolutely loved the experience! The ambience is really nice, but what stood out the most to me was the seating arrangement. They have a private seating area on the top floor, which is super comfortable and perfect for families of 5–6 or even for celebrating special occasions like birthday dinners with friends. It gives you a cozy, round-table dining experience while still maintaining your privacy.

The service was amazing..very attentive and smooth throughout.

Coming to the food, it was delicious! This place is especially great for non-veg lovers. Their mutton dishes are a must-try, particularly the Mughlai-style preparations. The menu is quite unique and offers some great options.

Overall, I had a great experience and would definitely recommend it. Plus, it’s open till 4 AM, which makes it even better for late-night outings!

featured_reviews.name: Akash Karkera
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Jyran at the Sofitel BKC last Friday (Jan 16) with a group of friends, and it was the perfect start to the weekend. The "Modern Nawabi" ambiance and the stunning metal elephant sculpture in the courtyard set the stage for a truly upscale dining experience.
We started with the Aloo Chaat, which was a delightful explosion of tangy and spicy flavors. For starters, the Veg Aloo was beautifully prepared, but the Chicken Tandoori was the clear standout, perfectly charred, smoky, and incredibly succulent. It is rare to find tandoori chicken that remains this moist while packing such a deep punch of traditional spices.
For the main course, the Veg Dum Biryani was a masterclass in slow-cooked perfection. The aroma upon opening the "dum" seal was divine, with every grain of long-grain basmati rice infused with saffron and aromatic spices.
The service was impeccable despite the Friday night rush, making us feel truly welcomed. If you’re looking for authentic Northwest Frontier cuisine in a luxury setting, Jyran is the place to be. I can’t wait to return with the squad!

featured_reviews.name: Manish Agarvwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a wonderful dining experience at JYRAN – Tandoor Dining & Lounge at Sofitel BKC.

The ambience is absolutely stunning, made even more special by the soulful live ghazal performance that created the perfect evening atmosphere.

We started with the Veg Seekh Kebab and Rajma Galouti Kebab, and both were exceptional—flavourful, well-balanced, and beautifully prepared. For the main course, the Achari Paneer was packed with authentic flavours, while the Dal Makhni was simply outstanding and among the best we’ve had in a long time.

The highlight of the evening was undoubtedly the Jyran Special Falooda. Its unique presentation and distinctive taste made for a memorable finish to an already fantastic meal.

A special mention to Chef Kishan Samant for curating such delicious dishes and ensuring a remarkable culinary experience. His passion and attention to detail were evident in every course.

Kartik and Rahul were very courteous and served us with a smile.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy great food, elegant ambience, and live music in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Saroj
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of dining at Jyran – Tandoor Dining, and I must say the experience was truly exceptional. From the very moment I arrived, the warmth of the welcome and the graceful way I was escorted to my table set the tone for a wonderful evening.

I would especially like to appreciate Santosh, who is an incredibly helpful and attentive staff member. His service was outstanding throughout the evening. He handled everything with great professionalism — from suggesting beverages that perfectly complemented the meal to ensuring that every detail at the table was taken care of seamlessly. His command of English and his polite, confident communication style added a very refined touch to the overall experience.

When I arrived, I was honestly not in the best mood. However, Santosh’s courteous behavior, pleasant personality, and engaging yet respectful conversation completely transformed my evening. It is rare to come across someone who not only serves food but also uplifts the guest’s mood with such natural hospitality.

The food was absolutely delicious, rich in authentic flavors, and beautifully presented. Combined with such impeccable service, the entire dining experience felt truly luxurious and memorable.

I would highly recommend Jyran to my friends and relatives — not only for its exquisite cuisine but also for the exceptional service that makes every guest feel valued and special.

Looking forward to visiting again soon.
